title: Google Website Translator | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Google Website Translator Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000044521 Overview Growing and managing an international directory or membership website can be challenging… especially if the members and users speak different languages. The Google Website Translator add-on will add a drop-down menu to the website, allowing users to select their language. Once selected, Google Translate will be used to translate the front-end of the website to the user’s selected language. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Google Website Translator Add-On Enabling the Add-On 1. Settings » Design Settings » General » Header Design: This tool will appear in the header: To revert the site back to the original language, use the " Show Original " button that appears at the top of the web page: ** Google Translate won't show the default website language as an option in the drop-down because technically, there is no need to translate it since that's the main language of the website. ** Additional Functionality The admin will be able to change the wording that displays instead of the usual "Select Language" by editing the text label select_language_option_google_translate : By default it will be blank making the "Select Language" appear, once the new text is added it will replace it: With this add-on it is also possible to limit the languages available that can be translated. To do this, follow the steps below. 1. Go to Settings » Advanced Settings, search for: » translate_languages Edit the languages here - See the list of the languages using the link below: https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/languages For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
